name: tile_occupancy_test
return: D0.l = -1 when usable; 0 when out of bounds, occupied, or too near another MOB

name: scan_move_path_interactions
arguments: int16 (*neighbor_probe)(uint16 packed_slot), uint16 packed_slot, uint16 player_index
exceptional_convention: calls the supplied probe through A2 until negative/blocked; resolves removable interior objects

name: resolve_move_tile_interaction
return: D0.l = -1 when interaction/type blocks continued cleanup; 0 after removable-object cleanup
exceptional_convention: normal stack; recursive for type 0x0F after thief/exit cleanup

name: nearby_mob_clearance_test
return: D0.l = -1 when clear; 0 when a qualifying nearby MOB overlaps the 0x7C0 axis window
exceptional_convention: second argument 0-3 excludes that player's own hpos nibble 12+index; 4 excludes none

name: path_grid_set_low_direction
exceptional_convention: normal stack; writes direction+1 to low nibble of a 44-column/128-byte-stride grid

name: path_grid_set_high_direction_if_empty
exceptional_convention: normal stack; no-op in thief-mode bit 1 or when high nibble is already nonzero

name: path_grid_get_direction
return: D0.l = direction 0-7; 8 when the selected nibble is unset/invalid
exceptional_convention: normal stack; bit 1 of thief mode selects high nibble, otherwise low nibble

name: calc_direction
return: D0.w = direction 0-7; 8 when positions are equal
exceptional_convention: normal stack; honors horizontal/vertical wrap flags

name: door_open_start
arguments: uint16 packed_door_slot, uint16 player_index, uint16 door_object_type
exceptional_convention: normal stack; fills that player's two endpoint positions/directions and calls main_open_doors

name: door_scan_vertical_endpoints
arguments: uint16 packed_door_slot, uint16 player_index, uint16 next_endpoint_index
return: D0.l = updated endpoint index, clamped at 2
exceptional_convention: normal stack; tests only the immediate above/below cells and writes direction codes 0/2

name: door_scan_horizontal_endpoints
arguments: uint16 packed_door_slot, uint16 player_index, uint16 next_endpoint_index
return: D0.l = updated endpoint index, clamped at 2
exceptional_convention: normal stack; tests only the immediate left/right cells and writes direction codes 3/1
